name: Fae-Lure Lanterns
introDiscord:
Floating Fae lanterns illuminate the grove ahead. Some lead toward
safe paths. Some lead toward treasure. Some are attached to enormous
teeth. The forest provides no labeling system.
introTwitch:
Floating Fae lanterns illuminate the grove ahead. Some lead toward
safe paths. Some lead toward treasure. Some are attached to enormous
teeth. The forest provides no labeling system.

fae-lure-lanterns-approach.prompt:
Three routes are marked by drifting lights: silver, blue, and a very
friendly-looking gold.

left.message:
Restorative sap rests beneath a genuine Fae lantern. Shizuki added a
sign:

'REAL LIGHT.

Checked for teeth TWICE.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the sap untouched. The lantern continues its successful
career as a non-predatory object.

right.message:
The golden lantern drifts closer.

You wait.

It blinks.

Lanterns do not blink.

A Fae-Lure Angler lunges from the darkness.

forward.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer sits beneath three harmless Fae lights.
Inside are Star Candies and one handwritten tag:

'These lights passed inspection.'

fae-lure-lanterns-depths.prompt:
Towering kelp columns hide dozens of floating lanterns. Three routes
vanish beneath their glow.

left.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's homemade identification chart:

'FAE LIGHT:
pretty.

ANGLER:
pretty + teeth.

This chart took longer to make than I am proud of.'

right.message:
An offering basket sits beneath a blue lantern. You stare at the light
for an unnecessarily long time before opening the basket.

No teeth.

Star Candies acquired.

forward.message:
A helpful little lantern begins guiding you down the passage.

How thoughtful.

It leads directly to the Angler attached to it.

fae-lure-lanterns-threshold.prompt:
Living rootways converge around False-Light Chapel, where three doors
are each illuminated by a single hovering glow.

left.message:
One lantern casts no shadow.

You have learned enough.

The Fae-Lure Angler realizes you have learned enough.

Combat begins.

right.message:
A tranquil grove pool glows beneath Shizuki's final inspection notice:

'POOL SAFE.
LIGHT SAFE.
ROOT SAFE.
I checked EVERYTHING.

Glimmer checked me.'
right.fullHpMessage:
You leave the safe pool safely unused. A rare victory for quality
control.

forward.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a Star Candy cache beneath an honest little
Fae lantern.

You thank it for not possessing a mouth.

boss-antechamber.name: False-Light Chapel
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every genuine Fae lantern in the Chapel suddenly goes dark.

One enormous light remains.

bossPromptDiscord:
The last glow floats alone inside False-Light Chapel.

It brightens.

Then rises.

Then reveals a shadow much larger than the lantern could possibly
belong to.

You have seen this trick before.

Never at this scale.

Use /yes to enter the Chapel or /no to refuse the forest's largest
false advertisement.
bossPromptTwitch:
The last glow floats alone inside False-Light Chapel.

It brightens.

Then rises.

Then reveals a shadow much larger than the lantern could possibly
belong to.

You have seen this trick before.

Never at this scale.

Use !yes to enter the Chapel or !no to refuse the forest's largest
false advertisement.
bossRetreatText:
You withdraw. The enormous lure remains glowing behind you with
offensively innocent beauty.

boss.revealText:
The false lantern swings upward as an enormous jaw emerges beneath it.

Glamourmaw Angler reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Glamourmaw disappears into the dark kelp.

One genuine Fae lantern relights beside the exit.

You stare at it.

It has earned nothing."
